description: This file defines the MedicalAgent class responsible for generating medical recommendations based on user queries. It utilizes a vector store for guideline snippets and provides symptom-specific medication suggestions with safety caveats and disclaimers.

classes.name: MedicalAgent
classes.description: A class that provides symptom-based medical recommendations with safety disclaimers and medication suggestions, leveraging a vector store for guideline retrieval.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the MedicalAgent instance and loads the guideline vector store.

methods.name: List[str] _medicine_suggestions(self, user_query: str)
methods.description: Generates a list of heuristic medication suggestions based on keywords present in the user query.

methods.name: List[str] _dedupe_preserve_order(self, items: List[str])
methods.description: Removes duplicate items from a list while maintaining their original order.

methods.name: List[str] recommend(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3, allow_meds: bool = True)
methods.description: Retrieves relevant guideline snippets, adds medication suggestions when appropriate, and appends a safety disclaimer to produce user-facing recommendations.

ctags.name: recommend
ctags.pattern: /^    def recommend(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3, allow_meds: bool = True) -> List[str]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, user_query: str, k: int = 3, allow_meds: bool = True)
